problem: Initial outer index excluded every basename MANIFEST_SHA256.json, including two preserved nested raw manifests.
effect: The two files were retained and raw-byte checked but not covered by the initial outer file index. No source or PDF changed.
correction: Exclude only the exact outer root/manifest path in both the indexer and verifier; assert ZIP file count equals indexed payload count plus one.
validation: The corrected whole-file index and byte-for-byte ZIP comparison are run before delivery.

save_roundtrip_issue.effect: Three saved PDFs and the full extracted edition remained intact; only the saved archive was incomplete.
save_roundtrip_issue.repair: Build and verify a temporary archive, fsync, atomically replace the delivery path, then replace the same saved archive identity and verify the saved bytes.
